'''M2-AX Patrol Droid''' was a [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol droid]] model used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. These droids patrolled the Republic power generator in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
M2-AX Patrol Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
